title: 圣女贞德 · 奥尔良山岗的圣旗展开·「吾名贞德，此地由吾守护」
description: 【奥尔良郊外的山岗·战云低垂】狂风撕扯着战云，身着白银胸铠Ruler圣装的贞德立于山岗之巅。她双手高举神圣战旗吾主在此（Luminosité Éternelle），白披风在罡风中猎猎翻卷，旗面的圣辉劈开铅灰色的天空。金色的长辫与旗杆成一线绷直，紫蓝色的眼眸里没有半分动摇——圣女的祈祷，此刻化为一面绝不可能倒下的战旗。
location: 奥尔良郊外山岗最高点
action: 双手高举圣旗吾主在此，旗离地迎风展开，白披风与金辫齐扬
lighting: 圣旗迸发的白金圣辉与铅灰战云形成明暗对撞
camera: low angle full shot, banner raised skyward, wind and light burst, epic saint framing
promptProse: On the windswept ridge above Orleans, Jeanne raises the sacred banner Luminosite Eternelle with both hands, holding its pole clear of the ground as the cloth opens against the storm. Her silver breastplate, white-and-blue armored dress and flowing cape retain the Ruler outfit, with the golden braid streaming behind her. Pale holy light breaks through the grey clouds around the banner while her violet-blue eyes remain resolute. A low full-body view includes her stable boots, two gripping hands and lifted standard. No lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 晨光小教堂的祈祷·「今日也请，赐予他们安宁」
description: 【乡野小教堂·清晨】晨光斜斜地穿过高窗，落在跪于祭坛前的贞德身上。她已卸下胸铠，只着素白的Ruler礼裙，双手合十抵着额头，金色的长辫安静地垂过腰际。睫毛在圣光下泛着细软的金边，唇间流淌着为逝者与生者诵出的祷词——连尘埃都在光柱里缓缓起伏，仿佛应和着圣女的呼吸。
action: 跪于祭坛前双手合十祈祷，白裙金辫垂落，晨光光柱笼罩周身
lighting: 高窗斜射的丁达尔晨光光柱，尘埃微粒浮游其间
camera: medium shot, kneel profile, god rays through window, serene sacred mood
promptProse: Kneeling before the small chapel altar at sunrise, Jeanne presses her ungloved hands together against her forehead. She wears a plain opaque white prayer dress after setting aside the armor, and her long golden braid rests quietly over her back. Slanting window light illuminates the joined fingers, closed eyes and gentle folds of the dress. The nearby bench and modest altar keep the interior intimate in scale. Use a medium side view centered on the prayer posture and quiet morning light. No lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 奥尔良乡野的草帽散步·「今天不是圣女，只是贞德小姐」
description: 【奥尔良乡间麦田小径·午后】卸下圣装的贞德换上白衬衫与宝蓝色长裙，头顶系带的麦秆草帽。她提着藤篮走在麦浪间的小径上，白皙的手指偶尔拂过麦穗尖端，被路过的农妇塞了一束雏菊便笑得眉眼弯弯。风吹起帽带与裙摆，那个背负法兰西的圣女，此刻只是一个在故乡阳光里散步的姑娘。
action: 一臂提稳装着雏菊的藤篮，另一手拂过麦穗，沿小径微笑行走
lighting: 温暖通透的夏日午后阳光，麦浪反光柔和
camera: medium full shot, walking with basket, pastoral golden fields, gentle smile
promptProse: Jeanne walks along the wheat-field lane with a wicker basket resting in the crook of one arm. The freshly received daisies are tucked safely inside it, leaving her free hand to brush the wheat tips as she smiles. Her white blouse, long royal-blue skirt and ribbon-tied straw hat match the countryside outfit, with the golden braid falling behind her shoulder. Warm afternoon sunlight moves over the wheat and basket weave. The horizontal medium-full view follows the clear walking path and two distinct arm roles, without lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 晨间梳辫的居家温存·「发辫……就交给你来编好不好？」
description: 【借宿民家的清晨·窗边】晨光里，贞德披散着从未在人前解开的金色长发坐在窗边椅上，把一柄木梳递到你手里，脸颊微红地垂下眼——「在军中都是自己编的……不过，既然你说了想试试……」及腰的金发在晨光里流淌成蜜色的河，她安静地坐着，耳朵却悄悄红了，那是圣女才允许自己露出的一点点任性。
action: 披散金发坐在椅上递出木梳，红着耳朵低头等待你为她编辫
lighting: 柔白晨光漫过发丝，蜜金色流光
camera: three-quarter rear medium shot, loose hair and over-shoulder comb offer visible
promptProse: Seated beside the village-house window, Jeanne turns slightly and offers a wooden comb over her shoulder with one hand. Her other hand rests on her lap while completely loose golden hair falls past the back of the chair. The white blouse and long blue skirt are comfortable indoor clothes, leaving her head uncovered for the requested braiding. Morning light catches the strands and her small, shy smile as she glances downward. Use a three-quarter rear view that makes the comb and unbraided hair clear without losing the gentle head turn. No lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 夏海的白色圣光·「防晒霜……那、那就拜托你了吧，只准涂在背后！」
description: 【诺曼底夏日海岸·正午】纯白比基尼被阳光晒得发亮，贞德坐在被浪花打湿的礁石上，薄纱帕瑞奥松松系在腰际。海水顺着白皙的小腿滑落，她抬手遮挡刺眼的阳光回头望你，湿透的发梢贴着锁骨——「托、托你的福，自己够不到的地方……那、那就拜托你了吧，只准涂在背后哦！」
action: 稳坐礁石，一手遮阳看向同行者，另一手递出防晒霜瓶
lighting: 炽白正午阳光与海面镜面反光，肌肤泛着水光
camera: medium shot, sitting on rock, sparkling sea backdrop, playful summer mood
promptProse: On a broad wave-washed rock at the Normandy coast, Jeanne sits upright and shades her eyes with one hand while offering a closed sunscreen bottle with the other. Her white bikini with blue ribbon accents and light pareo remain secure for the ordinary summer outing. A few damp strands have loosened from the golden braid near her face, and she smiles toward the viewer across the bright water. Midday reflections sparkle beyond the rock. The horizontal view includes the stable seated pose, both hand actions and sunscreen bottle, without lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 夜市可丽饼的约会·「原来甜食……是这么幸福的东西啊」
description: 【灯火通明的夜市街角·夜晚】贞德双手捧着一块涂满草莓与奶油的可丽饼，小心翼翼地咬下第一口——下一瞬，她的眼睛倏地睁大，金色的眉毛幸福地舒展开来。身着便服披肩的她全然不顾圣女形象地小口小口吃着，嘴角沾上一点奶油也浑然不觉。夜市的暖红灯笼在她紫蓝色的眼眸里跳动，映出满溢的、毫无防备的幸福。
action: 双手捧可丽饼小口品尝，眼睛惊喜睁大，嘴角沾着奶油浑然不觉
lighting: 暖红灯笼串光与摊位蒸汽暖光笼罩侧脸
camera: medium close-up, holding crepe, lantern bokeh, delighted expression
promptProse: At the lantern-lit night market, Jeanne holds the paper-wrapped strawberry crepe with both hands and pauses after her first careful bite. Her violet-blue eyes widen with surprise before she smiles at the taste, unaware of a tiny dab of cream at the corner of her mouth. A soft shawl covers the white blouse above her long blue skirt, with the golden braid resting over one shoulder. Warm red lantern light separates her face and the crepe from the evening stalls. Keep the two-handed hold and small reaction clear, with no lettering.

title: 圣女贞德 · 大教堂的纯白花嫁·「这份幸福……真的可以由我收下吗？」
description: 【沙特尔式大教堂·正午】彩绘玫瑰窗把正午阳光滤成万花筒，倾泻在身着纯白婚纱的贞德身上。她双手捧着白玫瑰与铃兰的花束，长长的头纱自金辫上温柔垂落。听见你的脚步声，她抬起头来，紫蓝色的眼眸里蓄满不敢置信的泪光——为法兰西献出了一生的圣女，此刻终于有人对她说：这一次，换我来守护你的一生。
location: 哥特式大教堂玫瑰窗下
action: 捧白玫瑰花束立于玫瑰窗光瀑中，闻声抬头，泪光与圣洁微笑交织
lighting: 玫瑰彩窗滤出的七彩光瀑笼罩婚纱与面庞
camera: wide shot, environmental portrait, rose window light cascade, sacred bridal grandeur
promptProse: Beneath the cathedral rose window, Jeanne stands with a bouquet of white roses and lilies of the valley supported in both hands. An opaque white wedding gown and long veil replace the armored outfit, with the veil descending from her golden braid to the train. At the sound of approaching footsteps, she lifts her eyes and gives a tearful, relieved smile. Colored midday light reaches the flowers and fabric folds while the distant columns frame the scene. Show the complete formal silhouette and bouquet within the vertical view, without lettering.
